brand.name: Old Lines
brand.tagline: Stories from the history of transit

scenes.text: By the 1890s, streetcars jammed the busiest streets of downtown Boston.
In 1895, the city began digging a tunnel to take them underground.
On September 1, 1897, the Tremont Street Subway opened, the first subway in the United States.
More than a century later, its tunnels still carry Green Line trains.

plates.label: Still in service on the Green Line
